title: Months Left at Exit and the C&I Exit Damages Rate
content:
*Scope: Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts. Subject: contract exits: term left at exit.*

The exit damages rate is scaled by the whole months left in the term at exit, counted from the close date to the contract end date with a partial final month left out: fewer than 12 scale it by 0.75, 12 up to 23 scale it by 0.90, and 24 or more leave it unscaled. Scaling multiplies the exit damages rate per kWh by the figure shown.

Whole months are calendar months from the close date, a month being complete on the same day of the month as the close date.

| Whole months left at exit | Exit damages rate multiplied by |
|---|---|
| fewer than 12 | 0.75 |
| 12 to 23 | 0.90 |
| 24 or more | 1, unscaled |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical)

| Close date | Contract end date | Whole months left | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 February 2026 | 11 February 2027 | 11 | 0.75 |
| 12 February 2026 | 12 February 2027 | 12 | 0.90 |
| 12 February 2026 | 31 October 2027 | 20 | 0.90 |
| 12 February 2026 | 12 February 2028 | 24 | 1 |
